title: Concept: HashiCorp Consul UI disclosed
description: The Consul UI is served at this endpoint, so the service catalogue and key-value console are reachable from this network position.
applicability: Responses served by a Consul agent HTTP interface.
risk: A reachable Consul UI exposes service names and key-value paths after login and can show ACL token identifiers; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove that a read is permitted.
